matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the placement of the indicator function in Equation 1 (the policy objective) and its inconsistency with the BC term's stated purpose during warm-up. All three findings address different equations in the appendix or Section 3.3 about surrogate gradient definitions and properties, not the policy objective formulation.

GT2 concerns Equation 7's adaptive slope scheduler and the undefined derivative computation (r′ vs Δr). None of the findings address the slope scheduler; all three focus on surrogate gradient derivative formulations in different parts of the paper.

GT3 concerns Equation 4's soft-reset mechanism and the inconsistency between β(U[t] - s·U_thr) versus β U[t] - s·U_thr. None of the findings address the spiking neuron reset mechanism; all focus on surrogate gradient mathematical properties.
